sparseposer.note: Unmodified official code/weights; local six-input wrapper and separate bilateral shin refinement. Not retrained as an eight-input model. Inference/preview only; no GMR or robot publishing from this entry point.

vive_ultimate_tracker_linux_sdk.note: Unmodified upstream reference. Runtime integration targets VIVE Hub Linux VUT protocol v1.

vive_hub_linux.note: Proprietary beta downloaded only after explicit EULA acknowledgement; not committed.

space_calibrator_linux.note: Unmodified upstream plus pinned ImGui submodule. Built out of tree; local VUT-to-OpenVR driver is separate in tools/vut_openvr.

openvr_sdk.note: Original unmodified SDK checkout preserved. Superseded for builds by openvr_sdk_steamvr_2_12_14: this SDK requests IVRSystem_026, unavailable in SteamVR 2.12.14.

openvr_sdk_steamvr_2_12_14.note: Unmodified release, IVRSystem_023. Selected build dependency for xi-ve UI and subsequent separate tracker driver builds; no xi-ve source patch. UI runtime search path prioritizes host GLVND (/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu) over conda GLX to avoid ImGui loader failure.

steamvr_pinned.source: Valve Steam CDN, fixed depot manifests, anonymous licensed download via DepotDownloader 3.4.0
steamvr_pinned.note: Separate from Steam-managed install. Unmodified Valve binaries; executable permissions restored and standard ALVR 20.14.1 compositor wrapper symlink installed. Optional retired depot 250829 (resources/readme.txt, 22 bytes) unavailable anonymously and omitted. Core binary hashes: config/steamvr_2.12.14.sha256.
